questions.question: Choose the correct option to complete the sentence: She told me that she _____ to the cinema the previous night.
Select the correct form of the verb in the following reported speech: 'If I had known you were coming, I would have baked a cake.'
options: If I had known you were coming, I would bake a cake.

questions.question: Which of the following sentences correctly reports the statement: 'I am leaving for London tomorrow.'?
options: He said that he is leaving for London tomorrow.
He said that he was leaving for London the next day.

He said that he was leaving for London the next day.
questions.answer: He said that he was leaving for London the next day.
